3. Pursuant to the notice issued by the Coordinate Bench on 08.01.2025, the informant is represented through her lawyer.

4. The contention of the petitioner is that the husband is ready to keep his wife and on instruction,
learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the lady is also ready to be part of the relationship they had after they solemnized the marriage.
5.
